technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early momentum reversal signals, but price remains below all key moving averages with bearish MACD and weak ADX strength—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 27 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (555+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (381.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 27 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with stochastic crossover and Awesome Oscillator twin peaks signal early momentum reversal in fear-driven market, offering contrarian entry near support at 55.16.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, weak ADX, sub-1.0 volume ratio, zero fundamental catalysts, high earnings risk in 27 days, and macro crisis conditions (VIX 381.4, rising dollar, recession yield curve) create overwhelming headwinds that overshadow oversold technicals.
